name: PureStart
description: A Safari-style start page for Edge and Chrome. No accounts, no telemetry, no ads.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https: http:; font-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; child-src 'none'; manifest-src 'self'; media-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
